Files in this folder are copies of open-source libraries, hosted on our own site so pages do not depend on outside CDNs
(fewer DNS lookups, one connection, works better on slow networks).

supabase.min.js            @supabase/supabase-js 2.45.4   MIT
three.min.js               three.js r128 (npm three@0.128.0)  MIT
gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js   GSAP 3.12.5            GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence (gsap.com/standard-license)
lenis.min.js               Lenis 1.1.13                   MIT
chart.umd.js               Chart.js 4.4.1                 MIT
confetti.browser.min.js    canvas-confetti 1.9.3          ISC
lucide-lite.js             icons from lucide 0.460.0, only the ones this site uses   ISC (lucide.dev)

Fonts (../fonts): Unbounded, Manrope and JetBrains Mono, variable fonts, latin and latin-ext subsets, via Fontsource. SIL Open Font License 1.1.
v2-agent-dark-3d/assets/founder.jpg is the same stock photo the page used to load from Unsplash (Unsplash licence).

To update a library: download the new version into this folder and change the version above.
